lines.line: Summary: One star is the only level where the police do not use their guns; they try to arrest you instead.

quoted: This is the only level where the police will not use their firearms
Instead they will seek to arrest the player.

lines.line: Weak points: The search circle at one star is about two city blocks across, and police cars chase at a moderate speed and try to box you in rather than ram you.

quoted: Police Cars will chase the player at moderate speed, trying to corral and box in rather than collide with the player's vehicle.
The search radius for one star is approximately two city blocks in size.

lines.line: Tips: One star comes from minor things such as attacking civilians, damaging a vehicle, stealing a car in sight of police or passing a toll booth without paying. On foot you can resist arrest, but that jumps you to two stars and the police start shooting; keeping a one-star level for a while also leads to two stars.

quoted: One star is for relatively minor offences
Attacking civilians
Damaging a vehicle
Stealing a vehicle of any type in sight of any authority
Passing a toll booth without paying
The player can get arrested while on foot (only with one star) or in a stationary vehicle.
In the former case, the player can resist arrest, which will immediately spark a two-star wanted level and cause the police to start firing their guns.
Maintaining a one-star wanted level for a certain amount of time

lines.line: Summary: From two stars the police use their guns, which can include pump shotguns, and in chases they try to overtake you or run you off the road.

quoted: From two stars onwards, the police will use their firearms, which may include pump shotguns.
During chases, they will try to overtake the player or run them off-road.

lines.line: Danger: More police cars arrive and fit officers in the front passenger seats step out with pump shotguns; if you crash, they use their cars to box you in.

quoted: When the player reaches two stars, additional police vehicles are sent to the area, and the officers in the front passenger seats of the vehicles will step out wielding Pump Shotguns (if fit cops are spotted).
They will also use their cars to try and box the player in if they crash.

lines.line: Tips: Two stars come from firing a gun or setting off an explosion near an officer, repeatedly punching an officer, killing many people quickly, destroying a fuel pump at a gas station or a Gruppe 6 Securicar, and resisting arrest.

quoted: Discharging a firearm or detonating an explosive device in the vicinity of a police officer
Repeatedly punching a police officer
Killing many people in a short space of time
Destroying a fuel pump at a gas station
Destroying a Gruppe 6 Securicar
Resisting arrest

sections.name: Wanted level three stars (NOOSE, Police Maverick)

lines.line: Summary: Three stars bring NOOSE, who set up roadblocks on main roads and bridges and send Cruisers and Patriots (the Patriots try to ram you head-on), plus a Police Maverick overhead that shines a spotlight on you at night and fires when its officers get a clear shot.

quoted: The NOOSE Patriotism and Immigration Authority will step in, setting up roadblocks on main roads and bridges and deploying Cruisers and Patriots to track the player down.
The NOOSE Patriots will attempt to ram the player head-on
The LCPD will also deploy a Police Maverick, which will shine a spotlight on the player at night and open fire if the police officers on board get a clear shot.

lines.line: Weak points: The helicopter now and then breaks off and retreats if you go underground, stay inside a large structure for a long time, or kill both riflemen on board.

quoted: The helicopter will periodically break off from pursuit and retreat if the player goes underground, stays inside a large structure for a long time, or kills both riflemen on board.

lines.line: Tips: From three stars you can no longer board the subway, and Police Predator patrol boats are sent if you are in or near water. Three stars come from killing or wounding an officer with a gun, or from carrying on with the damage and fighting back at the police.

quoted: From three stars onwards, the player will lose the ability to board the subway.
Police Predators are dispatched if the player is in or near water.
Killing or wounding a police officer with a firearm
Continuing to cause collateral damage (killing civilians/destroying vehicles)
Continuing to retaliate against the Police.
The Police Predator is a fast patrol boat appearing in Grand Theft Auto IV

sections.name: Wanted level four stars (FIB, NOOSE Tactical Response Unit)

lines.line: Summary: At four stars the FIB or the NOOSE Tactical Response Unit join in, in Enforcer armored vans or FIB Buffalo sedans with four officers each, and the search area grows to about the size of Bohan.

quoted: At four stars, the FIB or the NOOSE Tactical Response Unit join the fray and the player will be confronted by Enforcers or FIB Buffaloes
Tactical Response Unit Officers or FIB Agents come four to a vehicle
The search area is approximately the size of Bohan.
the Enforcer is depicted as a large armored transport van
small groups of the FIB agents will arrive in FIB Buffalo sedans to assist the LCPD

lines.line: Danger: They carry carbine rifles, some have SMGs and pump shotguns, and they wear body armor, so they take more gunfire before going down.

quoted: armed with Carbine Rifles, although some of them carry SMGs and Pump Shotguns, and wear body armor for protection
FIB agents are equipped with body armor, allowing them to withstand more gunfire before going down.

lines.line: Tips: They can take around 30 seconds to arrive, and the FIB seems more likely to show up when you drive fast or keep switching vehicles. Four stars also come from entering the runway at Francis International Airport or the grounds of the Civilization Committee in Algonquin.

quoted: although it may need for them to arrive a little longer than later levels (at around 30 seconds)
The FIB seems to be more likely to spawn when the player drives fast and/or constantly switches the vehicles.
Entering the runway area at Francis International Airport
Entering the grounds of the Civilization Committee in Algonquin

sections.name: Wanted level five and six stars (Annihilators, snipers)

lines.line: Summary: At five stars two NOOSE Annihilator helicopters replace the Police Mavericks, and in the main game every officer fires on you while chasing.

quoted: At five stars, the Police Mavericks will leave and be replaced by two NOOSE Annihilators.
In the main game and The Lost and Damned, all Law Enforcement Officers fire upon the player while in pursuit

lines.line: Danger: Officers try the PIT maneuver to spin you out, FIB and NOOSE units come in equal numbers, and in areas with tall buildings officers with Combat Sniper rifles shoot at you.

quoted: All Law Enforcement Officers employ more advanced driving techniques, such as the PIT Maneuver, as they try to make the player spin out of control and crash.
both forces spawning and pursuing the player in equal numbers
In areas with tall buildings, officers with Combat Sniper rifles will aim and shoot at the player when in their sights.

lines.line: Weak points: An Annihilator is very vulnerable to RPGs and assault rifles, and a single rocket straight into the fuselage destroys it.

quoted: it is very vulnerable to RPGs, Assault Rifles or other Annihilators
A single rocket directly to the fuselage can completely destroy the Annihilator

lines.line: Tips: At six stars the search area is about the size of Broker and Dukes, the military is not sent, and officers with PSG-1 sniper rifles keep spawning. Surviving six stars for five minutes earns the One Man Army achievement.

quoted: At a six-star wanted level, the search area is approximately the size of the borough of Broker and Dukes.
Unlike previous Grand Theft Auto games, the Military is not deployed.
The LCPD Officers armed with PSG-1 Sniper Rifles will continue to spawn.
The player can earn two Achievements/Trophies associated with the Wanted Level
One Man Army - Survive a six-star Wanted Level for five minutes.

lines.line: Summary: The police helicopter that arrives at three stars carries a pilot and two riflemen with carbine rifles, and the riflemen shoot you on sight.

quoted: The helicopters will have two LCPD riflemen equipped with Carbine Rifles (or Advanced MGs in The Ballad of Gay Tony) and an LCPD pilot on board; the riflemen will engage the suspect on sight.
programmed to shoot the player with Carbine Rifles

lines.line: Weak points: Its cockpit is exposed, so the people up front can be shot from tall places or with assault rifles, and the lower windows may be a weak spot when it flies above them.

quoted: Because of the rather exposed cockpit, the front occupants may get shot from enemies in tall places or armed with assault rifles, considering the lower windows may be a weak spot for them when flying above these.

lines.line: Tips: At four stars NOOSE crew replace the officers aboard if NOOSE is sent, and from five stars an Annihilator can replace the helicopter. Shooting the pilot lets it drift down undamaged about half the time; otherwise it spins and explodes.

quoted: with NOOSE TRU agents replacing police officers in Mavericks at four stars (provided that the FIB does not respond)
it may be replaced by the Annihilator from higher wanted levels, from five stars and above.

Obtainable by sniping the pilot, making the helicopter slowly hover to the ground undamaged. It only works 50% of the time; the rest of the time the Police Maverick will spin rapidly around in circles, hitting the ground with fierce force and exploding.

lines.line: Summary: A loose coalition of Jamaican gangs found mostly around Beechwood City in Broker, with a smaller presence in Schottler and Willis; their cars are painted green, black and gold.

quoted: They can mainly be found in the Beechwood City region, particularly the Homebrew Café, and have a smaller presence in Schottler and Willis as well.
They drive around in Voodoos and Huntleys painted in the colors of the Jamaican flag: green, black, and gold.
The Yardies, sometimes only referred to as the Jamaicans, are a loose coalition of Jamaican posses

lines.line: Weapons: They are well armed, with members on the streets carrying pistols, Micro SMGs and pump shotguns.

quoted: They are well-armed, with members on the streets carrying pistols, Micro Uzis and Pump Shotguns.

lines.line: Tips: Before the mission Shadow they are hostile if you attack them; they welcome you on their turf, and after Shadow they defend you if a pedestrian attacks you.

quoted: the Yardies welcome him to their turf.
If Niko is engaged in a fight or is attacked by a pedestrian, the Yardies will defend him by all means but this will only happen after Shadow.
Before that mission, Jamaicans will be hostile if you attack them.

lines.line: Summary: A Puerto Rican street gang, one of the largest in the game, with turf in South Bohan, Fortside (at night only), Cerveza Heights, East Holland and Alderney City, wearing black and gold or red and blue.

quoted: They are one of the largest street gangs operating in GTA IV
having turf in South Bohan, Fortside (night time only), Cerveza Heights
East Holland and Alderney City
Spanish Lords wear black and gold, also red and blue
The Spanish Lords are a Puerto Rican gang

lines.line: Weapons: At night they usually carry Micro SMGs and pistols, and one whose car you hit may step out with a knife.

quoted: Sometimes, if you hit a car belonging to one while he's in it, the gang member will come out with a Knife.
At night they usually walk around with Micro-SMGs and Pistols in case of fights.

lines.line: Tips: In Alderney City they share turf with the Korean Mob and do not fight each other; they sometimes ride in the same car, and both attack you if that car is damaged, and they turn on each other if you start a shoot-out.

quoted: In the Alderney City turf, since they share their turf with the Korean Mob, they don't attack each other
both will attack the player if the car is damaged.
They will however attack each other if the player provokes a shoot out

lines.line: Summary: A blue vest shown as a blue half-circle bar beside the radar, next to the green health bar; when you aim at an armored target, a small light blue circle shows by the reticle, usually on NOOSE and FIB agents.

quoted: When equipped, the HUD will represent it as a blue half-circle bar located next to the radar, along with the green health bar.
the weapon's reticle will have a smaller, light blue circle next to the health bar, usually seen on NOOSE/FIB agents.

lines.line: Uses: It pads your health against gunfire, explosions and fire, but it gives no protection from falls, being hit by a vehicle on foot, or melee attacks.

quoted: in effect extending the player's resilience to damage from gunfire, explosions and fire
It no longer offers protection to falls, collisions with vehicles on foot, or melee attacks (including hand-to-hand combat and melee weapons)

lines.line: Where to get it: The underground gun shops sell it for $500 once the mission Do You Have Protection? is done, it lies about the city with a red glow, and getting into an Enforcer van gives you only about a third of the full amount.

quoted: $500 (GTA IV & GTA Chinatown Wars)
Do You Have Protection? (GTA IV)
armor can be found lying about in specific points of the city (distinguishable by its red glow)
Enforcer armored vans still provide the player some armor, but only gives the player roughly one third of the maximum amount.
Body Armor
Do You Have Protection?

lines.line: Summary: Health packs shaped like medical kits lie all over Liberty City, mostly in out-of-the-way places, at hospitals and in subway stations.

quoted: In GTA IV, health pickups are shaped as medical kits.
In Grand Theft Auto IV, health packs are found all over Liberty City, generally in out-of-the-way locales, hospitals, and in subway stations.

lines.line: Uses: Eating at Cluckin' Bell or Burger Shot, or buying from street vendors and vending machines, restores health by different amounts, and drinks usually restore less.

quoted: the player can eat at fast food outlets (Cluckin' Bell and Burger Shot), as well as purchasing from street vendors and vending machines.
Food or drink replenishes health in varying degrees, with drinking usually replenishing health in smaller amounts.

lines.line: Tips: Dial 911 and then 2 for an ambulance, and the paramedics restore your health for a fee of up to $950, depending on how hurt you are. Maximum health cannot be raised in GTA IV, and saving the game also refills it.

quoted: Ambulances can be obtained by dialing 911 and choosing Ambulance by dialing 2 after the initial call. If the player is injured, paramedics who respond to the player will replenish their health for a fee of up to $950, depending on their remaining health points.
Health increase is no longer possible in the HD Universe games.
or by visiting a save point to save the game (in all 3D Universe titles, save for GTA III and Grand Theft Auto Advance, and in all HD Universe titles)

lines.line: Summary: Three underground gun shops stand in Downtown Broker, Chinatown in Algonquin and Port Tudor in Alderney, and they open with the mission Do You Have Protection?.

quoted: There is a total of 3 Underground Gun Shops in Liberty City. In Grand Theft Auto IV, they are accessible after completing Do You Have Protection?
Downtown, Broker, Liberty City
Chinatown, Algonquin, Liberty City
Port Tudor, Alderney

lines.line: Uses: You walk up to a table to look at a gun; ammo costs less than the gun, and the stock grows as the story goes on. A Pistol costs $600, a Pump Shotgun or Micro SMG $1,200, and an Assault Rifle $3,500.

quoted: To purchase weapons, the player has to walk up to the table and view them.
buying ammo for a weapon is cheaper than when buying the weapon
some weapons are unlocked inmediately after the player unlocks the first shop, but as the player progresses, more weapons will become available.
Pistol || $600
Pump Shotgun || $1,200
Micro SMG || $1,200
Assault Rifle || $3,500

lines.line: Tips: You cannot enter with a wanted level, because the door stays locked. Do not shoot the clerk: guards loitering at the entrance defend the shop, and if you kill the owner they attack with Combat Shotguns and SMGs and the shop will not sell to you for a while.

quoted: Players cannot enter the shops if they have a wanted level; upon arriving at the door, it will be locked
Some pedestrians can be found at the entrance to the shop loitering casually, but they are actually guards who will defend the shop.

Killing the owner of one of the shops results in the aforementioned guards armed with Combat Shotguns and SMGs attacking the player. It also prevents the player from buying weapons from that shop again for a period of time

lines.line: Summary: Four blocks of explosive with a phone wired to them, planted under a vehicle and set off by calling Packie and choosing Detonate.

quoted: this time as four explosive (possibly C-4) blocks with a phone attached to it via improvised wiring.
The bombs are remote detonated through calling Packie on the cell phone and selecting Detonate.

lines.line: Uses: Setting it off gives you no wanted level, which makes it a handy way to destroy Securicars.

quoted: Using it will not award a wanted level, being a useful weapon for destroying Securicars.

lines.line: Tips: You get car bombs from Packie as a friend favor, delivered to your general location, and you can place them beneath cars, buses and light vans only.

quoted: Car bombs can be obtained through Patrick McReary as a friend special option
They will be delivered to the player's general location and the player can place the bombs beneath cars, buses and light vans only.
